Reserve eUSD Main and timelock: recorded governance history
Research date: 29 September 2026. This is a read-only audit of returned public role and timelock events,
transaction receipts, verified source and fixed-block getters. It does not identify human wallet owners or
assess intentions.
Findings
The sampled Reserve eUSD Main contract has one OWNER in the reconstructed event history, 
0xc8ee187a5e5c9dc9b42414ddf861ffc615446a2c. The endpoint hasRole getter confirms that role. The address has
verified TimelockController source. Its ownership was established on 23 February 2023, before the
PulseChain fork. The Main role query returned 37 events from three inherited transactions and no
postfork RoleGranted or RoleRevoked event.
The owning timelock's selected event query returned 70 events across 14 transactions. All were
inherited: 37 scheduled calls, 25 executed calls, five role grants, one revocation and two minimum-delay
changes. It returned no postfork scheduled call, executed call, role grant, role revocation or
delay change through the endpoint. These observations do not show a postfork eUSD governance
execution in this Main/timelock pair.
The timelock's verified proposer is 0x7e880d8bd9c9612d6a9759f96acd23df4a4650e6, whose getter returns the
name Governor Alexios and identifies this same timelock. Unchanged Main ownership and the absence
of returned postfork timelock events do not exclude changed voting control of that governor. Governor
proposal, vote, delegation and token ownership histories were not enumerated in this bounded study.
Scope and pinned chain
The chain is PulseChain 369. Both event queries cover block zero through 27,659,393, hash 
0xc5e582cd902f4bff3b1aa325b9b564fcd5d6dc0ffa77a03fcd105b65c6390275, 28 September 2026 08:22:35 UTC. The
inherited-state comparison uses block 17,232,999, hash 
0xe5667f9cafb115b1dcfc36b0b569a5601f01dfa000698140a1298ef4f87e2e37.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 121

Each returned event was checked for inclusion in a successful receipt and for consistent transaction,
receipt and block-header hashes. Both event queries reported zero RPC errors. The endpoint header was
rechecked after collection. An empty postfork result remains scoped to the selected addresses and event
signatures and the RPC's historical completeness; it is not proof about every Reserve deployment or
every form of governance influence.
Main ownership and role history
Main is 0x7697ae4def3c3cd52493ba3a6f57fc6d8c59108a. Its OWNER role is the right-padded bytes32 ASCII string 
OWNER. The three recorded transactions are:
Date and time, UTC Block Main events Recorded role effect
23 February 2023 00:45:23 16,687,620 9 grants, 4 revocations Initial setup; OWNER
ultimately held by 0x24d0…
ed8e and 0x9494…e8c0 at this
transaction's end
23 February 2023 00:53:11 16,687,659 8 grants, 5 revocations OWNER granted to timelock
0xc8ee…6a2c; the two
preceding OWNER roles
revoked
23 February 2023 02:26:59 16,688,121 8 grants, 3 revocations Freezer and pauser
assignments changed; no
OWNER change
The supporting receipts are initial setup, timelock ownership assignment, and freezer/pauser
assignments.
All eleven accounts appearing in Main role events were checked against all four roles at both the
inherited boundary and endpoint: 44 hasRole responses per snapshot. The two sets of responses are
identical and match replay of the returned event history. The resulting current memberships are:
Role Addresses with true endpoint getter

SHORT_FREEZER 0xc8ee187a5e5c9dc9b42414ddf861ffc615446a2c; 
0x4986164f2fb9bb898b19382b1e835cd9c81eba46; 
0x4bad40e0d92ebc2620a0d5aff7887c7f2e67fdd8; 
0xe45c3179b135288dd8e1e3c20eafebb2b2e7d771; 
0x0d88776dd9a654cfe9c67b5b1d9ce2fddd815a34
LONG_FREEZER 0xc8ee187a5e5c9dc9b42414ddf861ffc615446a2c; 
0x0173e2965c1aec9d395eb14e3407ef95c2e1a47d
PAUSER 0xc8ee187a5e5c9dc9b42414ddf861ffc615446a2c; 
0x7f9ffa8dea49647725ca6ce621e03aa20401ff63; 
0x4bad40e0d92ebc2620a0d5aff7887c7f2e67fdd8; 
0xe45c3179b135288dd8e1e3c20eafebb2b2e7d771; 
0x0d88776dd9a654cfe9c67b5b1d9ce2fddd815a34
The earlier Reserve collateral study (Appendix 18) separately records false direct role getters for the
examined e121 account. This expanded history identifies the actual owning contract; it does not turn
that earlier direct-role result into a finding about indirect voting control.
pDAI stabilization thesis · 4 October 2026 122

Owning timelock and proposer
Explorer source identifies 0xc8ee187a5e5c9dc9b42414ddf861ffc615446a2c as TimelockController. Its role constants
and all five distinct role/account pairs returned in its grant/revocation history were checked at the
endpoint. Every check reconciles with the returned event history. Verified owning timelock source.
Role or getter Endpoint observation
TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE Timelock itself is true; setup contract 
0x24d0aaac80a457be7843c59d45a1b90fbb02ed8e is false
PROPOSER_ROLE 0x7e880d8bd9c9612d6a9759f96acd23df4a4650e6 is true
CANCELLER_ROLE 0x576ca79e46171a2b3e26f13a4334940ebcd72164 is true
EXECUTOR_ROLE Zero address is true, the verified source's open-execution
convention for otherwise eligible scheduled calls
getMinDelay 259,200 seconds, or three days
Proposer name() Governor Alexios
Proposer timelock() 0xc8ee187a5e5c9dc9b42414ddf861ffc615446a2c
Proposer token() 0x18ba6e33ceb80f077deb9260c9111e62f21ae7b8
The latest event in the selected timelock history occurred on 13 April 2023 15:58:59 UTC, block 
17,039,497, in transaction 0x0018…6567a. The 25 inherited CallExecuted events target Main eleven
times, AssetRegistry six times, BasketHandler three times, the governor twice, and the timelock,
BackingManager and 0x90eb22a31b69c29c34162e0e9278cc0617aa2b50 once each. These are counts of recorded
executed calls, not counts of proposals or proof of later activity. This study does not decode every
inherited operation's business purpose.
Reproduction and limits
Explicit event manifests:
Research/experiments/parb_reserve_governance_history_20260929.json
Research/experiments/parb_reserve_timelock_history_20260929.json
Run these through Research/scripts/collect_pulsechain_events.py using --manifest and a fresh --output. Explicit
getter manifests are parb_reserve_governance_holders_20260929.json, 
parb_reserve_governance_holders_inherited_20260929.json and parb_reserve_timelock_holders_20260929.json under 
Research/experiments/. Use Research/scripts/probe_pulsechain_routes.py --calls with the matching explicit block,
rather than its default experiment mode.
Raw RPC records, source, summary and SHA-256 hashes are preserved under ignored artifacts/parb-
reserve-governance-history-20260929/. The first timelock getter attempt failed at network connection before
producing an evidence file; a subsequent identical read completed. No failed call was treated as a false
role.
The study establishes recorded role assignments and selected governance executions for this eUSD
instance. It does not establish absence of changed voting power, common wallet ownership, activity at
another Reserve instance, or a running Reserve deployment on an unqueried pARB chain. No
transactions, administrative actions or state-changing simulations were performed. Production code was
not changed and production tests were not applicable.
